name: Cur8 Cart
author: cur8

sections.description:
Cur8 lists independent producers (breweries, roasters, wineries and distilleries) so people can find them and buy straight from their own shops. Cur8 doesn’t take payment and doesn’t sit between you and your customer.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce shop to your page on Cur8. It does two things:

  • It sends Cur8 your product list: names, prices, photos, stock and variations. It reads the list the way a logged-out visitor sees it, so drafts and private products never go out. It sends again whenever a product or its stock changes, and once a day.
  • When someone on Cur8 picks products from your shop, they arrive on your cart page with those products in it. They check out through WooCommerce as usual and pay you directly. The order and the customer are yours.

The plugin never reads, changes or sends your orders, customers or payment details.

You need a page on Cur8 that you’ve claimed, and an API key from its Shop connection page. The plugin does nothing until you paste that key in.

External services

This plugin connects to Cur8, a directory of independent producers run by Untangle Software Limited. It only does so once you’ve saved an API key from your Cur8 dashboard. The address it uses is the endpoint on its settings page, https://cur8beer.com/api/wc-plugin/verify unless you change it.

What it sends, and when:

  • Check in (the endpoint address): your API key and the plugin’s version number. Sent when you save the settings, when you press Check connection, and once after the plugin is updated. Cur8 replies with the name of your page so the settings page can show it.
  • Product list (the same address with /catalogue in place of /verify): your API key, the plugin’s version, and your products as a logged-out visitor sees them through WooCommerce’s public product list (names, descriptions, prices, photos, stock and variations). Sent about two minutes after a product or its stock changes, once a day, and when you press Send product list now.

What Cur8 asks your site for, always with your API key:

  • The countries you ship to, read from your WooCommerce shipping zones.
  • On older Cur8 links only, a basket to hold for a shopper on their way from Cur8.

Shoppers who come from Cur8 bring a link listing the products in their basket, signed with your API key. The plugin checks the signature before it adds anything to the cart. No personal or payment details about shoppers pass between your site and Cur8.

Cur8 terms of use: https://cur8beer.com/en/terms
Cur8 privacy policy: https://cur8beer.com/en/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your Cur8 dashboard, open Shop connection and generate an API key.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New, search for Cur8 Cart, then install and activate it.
  3. Go to Settings, Cur8 Cart. Paste your API key, check the endpoint matches the one on your Shop connection page, and save.
  4. The plugin checks in with Cur8 and sends your product list. Your Shop connection page shows the shop as connected.

Your products show on Cur8 once you’ve also switched product display on in your Cur8 dashboard.
sections.faq:
What does the plugin send to Cur8?

Your API key, the plugin’s version, and your product list as the public sees it: names, descriptions, prices, photos, stock and variations. Nothing about your orders, customers or payments.

Does Cur8 take a cut of my sales?

No. Shoppers pay you through your own WooCommerce checkout. Cur8 never handles the money.

How do I take my products off Cur8?

Switch product display off in your Cur8 dashboard, or make a new API key there, which stops the old one working straight away. Then you can deactivate and delete the plugin. Deactivating the plugin on its own doesn’t take your products off Cur8.

My site is behind Cloudflare or another firewall. Will it work?

Yes. Your shop sends the product list to Cur8, and basket links arrive with the shopper, so neither needs a request from Cur8’s servers to get through your firewall.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings, including your API key, are removed from your site.
sections.changelog:
1.6.2

  • Fixed an empty cart for shoppers whose basket link came in on your address without www (or with it, when your site runs without).

1.6.1

  • Translations of the settings page now come from translate.wordpress.org.

1.6.0

  • Declared compatible with WooCommerce’s order storage and the block cart and checkout. The plugin doesn’t touch orders.
  • Deleting the plugin now removes its settings.
  • Tidier input handling on basket links.

1.5.1

  • Fixed sending the product list from shops with variable products.

1.5.0

  • Basket links are signed by Cur8 and checked by the plugin, so baskets arrive even when a firewall turns away outside requests.

1.4.0

  • The plugin sends your product list to Cur8 itself, after each change and once a day.

short_description: Keeps your products on Cur8 up to date, and sends shoppers who find them to your own checkout with their basket already filled.
